integrity: All stated identities are proved analytically and supported by an exact-rational finite-horizon checker. The checker is not a substitute for the infinite theorem or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: For the full tent map and the measure uniform on all the fixed points of the nth iterate, including smaller periods. p finite remains fixed in asymptotics. Does not address primitive-only counts, other slopes, or general mixing maps. General literature priority remains provisional; a recent primary preprint was accessible only by abstract. The fixed-point rational grids were explicitly known in Chen and Dong (2010).
title: Sharp all-order transport quantization inefficiency of tent-map periodic points
